name: secureapi-gate
description: SecureAPI-Gate: a CI/CD security regression gate for REST APIs.

scripts.secureapi:scan:vulnerable: cross-env USER_TOKEN=demo-user-token MANAGER_TOKEN=demo-manager-token ADMIN_TOKEN=demo-admin-token npm run dev -w @secureapi-gate/cli -- scan --spec ../../examples/specs/openapi.demo.yaml --config ../../examples/configs/role-matrix.yml --policy ../../examples/configs/test-policy.yml --base-url http://localhost:3000 --out ../../evidence
scripts.secureapi:scan:fixed: cross-env USER_TOKEN=demo-user-token MANAGER_TOKEN=demo-manager-token ADMIN_TOKEN=demo-admin-token npm run dev -w @secureapi-gate/cli -- scan --spec ../../examples/specs/openapi.demo.yaml --config ../../examples/configs/role-matrix.yml --policy ../../examples/configs/test-policy.yml --base-url http://localhost:3000 --out ../../evidence
